title: What Is a Resolution in a Story?
skills: identify how a story resolves its central conflict
analyze how the ending addresses consequences and character outcomes
explain how resolution provides closure to a narrative
alignment_note: Introduces resolution as the concluding stage of a narrative in which major conflicts and story questions are addressed. Supports plot analysis, sequencing, interpretation of endings, and understanding of how resolution provides closure and reveals the consequences of earlier events across high school English courses.
